एतद् (I) pron. (m. एषः, f. एषा, n. एतत्) This, as pointing to what is nearest to the speaker (“समीपवर्ति चैतदो रूपम्”). It is sometimes used to give emphasis to the personal pronoun, e.g. एषोऽहं प्रलयनरुत्प्रचण्डरहः संक्षिप्तप्रथिम विषन्निवान्तरीक्षम् Mv.v. It often refers to what precedes when it is associated with another pronoun, e.g.
तदेतत्सर्वमरमणीयम् R.G. It is sometimes used in connection with a relative or correlative clause.
एतद् (II) ind. Thus, in this manner, at this time.
एतद्-प्रथम a. one who does anything for the first time.
एतदीय a. (f. या) Belonging to this, relating to this.
